claude_result_text:
The model now features larger window and door geometries to improve their visibility on the fuselage and hump surfaces, addressing the "solid grey block" feedback from the judge. Additionally, I have fixed a major structural incoherence where the wings and engines were floating; they are now correctly positioned so that the wing root integrates with the lower hull of the airplane body.

I've performed two primary fixes:
1. Adjusted `wingGroup` on line 56 to position it correctly relative to the fuselage, ensuring the wings are no longer disconnected from the body and engines hang naturally below them.
2. Increased the dimensions of the main deck windows in the loop starting at line 94 to make the window rows clearly visible as surface details across the entire length of the aircraft.

These changes address both the priority structural issues (attachment/placement) and the specific critique regarding "window_door_lines" by ensuring these features are distinct and realistic.
